name: Chronojet Dragon
kana: クロノジェット・ドラゴン
skillText:
[AUTO]: When this unit is placed on [V], choose 1 "Chronojet Dragon" Crest from your crest zone, and put it into your crest zone.
[AUTO](V): When you [Stride] a G unit, COST [Counter Blast (1)], choose one of your opponent's rear-guards, and put it on the bottom of their deck.
[CONT](V) Generation Break 2: During the battle that this unit attacks, this unit gets [Power]+5000, and your opponent cannot call grade 1 or greater cards from hand to [G].
flavorText: The roaring gear will surpass all dimensions and carve out a new era!

faqs.question: Can I use the on-stride Stride skill if my heart is Chronojet Dragon?
faqs.answer: Yes! The [AUTO] skill triggers when you Stride a G unit while Chronojet Dragon is on the Vanguard circle. You pay Counter Blast 1 to spin an opponent's rear-guard to the bottom of the deck.

faqs.question: Does Generation Break 2 activate when Chronojet restands after Chronodragon Nextage's attack?
faqs.answer: Yes! If you have two or more face-up G units in your G-Zone (Nextage turns face-up when it goes back to G-zone, plus any previously face-up G cards), GB2 is active for Chronojet's follow-up attack, giving it +5000 Power and locking grade 1+ guards from hand.

name: Smokegear Dragon
kana: スモークギア・ドラゴン
skillText:
[AUTO]: When this unit is rode upon by a grade 3 card with "Chronojet" in its card name, look at the top five cards of your deck, choose up to one grade 3 or greater card from among them, reveal it and put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
[CONT](R): If you have a grade 4 or greater vanguard, this unit gets "Boost", and [Power]+5000.
flavorText: The smoke signals the start of the time leap.

faqs.question: Can I search for G units with Smokegear's ride upon effect?
faqs.answer: No. G units are kept in your G-Zone, not inside your main deck. Smokegear searches the top 5 cards of your main deck for grade 3 or greater cards like additional Chronojet Dragon or Steam Fighter Balih.

name: Masergear Dragon
kana: メーザーギア・ドラゴン
skillText:
[AUTO]: When this unit is rode upon by "Smokegear Dragon", COST [discard a card from hand], and draw a card.
[AUTO](R): When this unit boosts, if you have a grade 4 or greater vanguard, COST [Counter Blast (1)], choose one of your opponent's rear-guards in the front row, and put it on the bottom of their deck.
flavorText: The light it emits cuts open the very fabric of space.

faqs.question: Can Masergear Dragon remove an interceptor during battle?
faqs.answer: Yes! When Masergear boosts an attacking unit, you can Counter Blast 1 to bottom-deck an opponent's front row rear-guard, removing their interceptor or threat before they can guard.

name: Chrono Dran
kana: クロノ・ドラン
skillText: [AUTO]: When this unit is rode upon, if you went second, draw a card.
flavorText: A small dragon holding the potential to command all timelines.

faqs.question: Does Chrono Dran go to the soul when ridden upon from the ride deck?
faqs.answer: Yes, standard ride deck rules apply: when Masergear Dragon is ridden over Chrono Dran, Chrono Dran moves to the soul, and if you went second, you draw a card.

name: Steam Fighter, Balih
kana: スチームファイター バリフ
skillText:
[AUTO]: When this card is discarded from hand for the cost of [Stride], draw a card.
[AUTO](R): When this unit's attack hits a vanguard, look at the top five cards of your deck, choose up to one grade 3 or greater card from among them, reveal it and put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavorText: A reliable veteran warrior who keeps the gears turning.

faqs.question: How does Balih make Stride free in terms of card advantage?
faqs.answer: Discarding Balih alone satisfies the Stride cost (Grade 3), and Balih's AUTO immediately triggers to draw a card, making your Stride discard cost +0 in card economy!

name: Upstream Dragon
kana: アップストリーム・ドラゴン
skillText: [AUTO](R): When this unit attacks a vanguard, if you have a grade 3 or greater vanguard with "Chronojet" in its card name, this unit gets [Power]+4000 until end of that battle. At the end of that battle, put this unit on the bottom of your deck, search your deck for up to one grade 1 card, call it to [R] as [Rest], and shuffle your deck.
flavorText: Swimming against the tides of time to bring reinforcement.

faqs.question: Can I call Steam Scara Gigi with Upstream Dragon?
faqs.answer: Yes! Upstream Dragon searches for any Grade 1 card. Calling Steam Scara Gigi triggers Gigi's SB2 draw effect, cycling a card and replacing the attacker.

faqs.question: Does Upstream Dragon return itself to the deck even if it gets guarded?
faqs.answer: Yes, the condition is 'When this unit attacks a vanguard', not on hit. At the end of the battle, it bottom-decks and tutor calls a Grade 1.

name: Steam Fighter, Argandia
kana: スチームファイター アルガンディア
skillText:
[AUTO]: When this unit is put on [G], if you have a grade 3 or greater vanguard, this unit gets [Shield]+5000 until end of that battle.
[AUTO](R): When your opponent's card is put on the bottom of their deck by your card's ability, this unit gets [Power]+5000 until end of turn.
flavorText: Heavy steam propulsion defends the temporal gates.

faqs.question: Does Argandia get shield boost when intercepting?
faqs.answer: Yes! Putting Argandia on [G] from hand or via Intercept gives it [Shield]+5000 (making it a 10,000 shield guardian) as long as your vanguard is Grade 3 or greater.

name: Steam Maiden, Arlim
kana: スチームメイデン アルリム
skillText:
[CONT]: Sentinel (You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]: Sentinel" in a deck.)
[AUTO]: When this unit is put on [G], choose one of your units, and it cannot be hit until end of that battle. If your hand has two or more cards, choose a card from your hand, and discard it.
flavorText: The timeless shield deflects any catastrophe.

faqs.question: Do I have to discard if Arlim is the only card in my hand?
faqs.answer: No! If you have only 1 card in hand (Arlim itself which was placed onto G), your remaining hand is 0 cards (< 2 cards), so no discard is required!

name: Steam Breath Dragon
kana: スチームブレス・ドラゴン
skillText:
[CONT](Hand): When this card would be discarded for the cost of [Stride], this card may be discarded as a grade 3.
[AUTO]: When this unit is placed on [R] from hand, COST [discard a card from hand], search your deck for up to one grade 3 card with "Chronojet" in its card name, reveal it and put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavorText: Its fiery breath calibrates the great temporal engine.

faqs.question: Can I discard Steam Breath Dragon alone for Stride?
faqs.answer: Yes! Its continuous effect in hand allows it to count as a Grade 3 card when paying the Stride cost.

name: Gear Serow of Magnetic Resonance
kana: 磁気共鳴のギアセロウ
skillText: [AUTO](R): When your card is put on the bottom of your deck from [R] or drop, this unit gets [Power]+5000 until end of turn.
flavorText: The magnetic resonance synchronizes clockwork gears perfectly.

faqs.question: Does Gear Serow gain power multiple times if multiple cards return?
faqs.answer: Yes! Each time a card is placed on the bottom of your deck from R or drop (e.g. from Upstream Dragon or Faterider Dragon), Serow gets +5000 Power, turning it into a 13k or 18k booster.

name: Steam Scara, Gigi

flavorText: A brilliant scholar cataloging the anomalies of time.

faqs.question: Can Gigi be called with Upstream Dragon to draw on the same turn?
faqs.answer: Yes! Upstream Dragon attacks, puts itself on the bottom of the deck, and calls Gigi from deck. Gigi's AUTO triggers immediately on placement, letting you Soul Blast 2 to draw a card.

faqs.question: What happens if Gallmageheld is checked during Chronodragon Nextage's Triple Drive?
faqs.answer: Nextage gains +100M power, draws 1, gets +1 Critical and +1 Drive (becoming Quadruple Drive!), and all front row units gain +10000 power. Combined with restanding Chronojet, it almost always ends the match!

name: Chronodragon Nextage
kana: クロノドラゴン・ネクステージ
skillText:
[Stride]-Stride Step-COST [Choose cards with the sum of their grades being 3 or greater from your hand, and discard them], [Stride] this card on your [V] from face down.

During that turn, that unit gets drive -1.
flavorText: Fly towards the future beyond time itself!

faqs.question: How many total drive checks do I get when attacking with Nextage?
faqs.answer: Nextage performs Triple Drive (3 drive checks). After the battle, it turns face up to Stand Chronojet Dragon. Chronojet attacks with Twin Drive (default 2 drives minus 1 from Nextage is 1, but Chronojet original is Twin Drive, giving 2-1 = 1 check; with Crest power and GB2 active, that gives a total of 4-5 drive checks across the two attacks!).

faqs.question: Does Chronojet get Crest power after Nextage goes back to the G zone?
faqs.answer: Yes! When Nextage returns face-up and you also flip another G-unit for cost, your face-up G zone count increases by 2 immediately, giving your Chronojet and front row +10,000 power more!

name: Interdimensional Dragon, Faterider Dragon
kana: 時空竜 フェイトライダー・ドラゴン

Choose one of your units, and it gets [Power]+10000 until end of turn for each face up card in your G zone.
flavorText: The destiny rider who reshapes history with every stride.

faqs.question: Can Faterider Dragon turn a Grade 1 into Upstream Dragon (Grade 2)?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can put a Grade 1 rear-guard (or even a rested unit) to the bottom of the deck, tutor out Upstream Dragon, and give Upstream or your Vanguard massive power (+10k per face up G unit!).

faqs.question: Does Faterider count itself if it's currently on the Vanguard circle?
faqs.answer: No, Faterider is currently on [V], not in the G-zone. However, the COST turns another card in your G-Zone face up, which immediately counts as 1 (giving +10,000 power on your very first Stride!).

flavorText: The ancient emblem of the Gear Colossus, channeling temporal energy across eras.

faqs.question: Where does the Crest card start the game?
faqs.answer: In standard D-Series rules, the Crest begins the game face down in your Crest Zone (outside the deck). When Chronojet Dragon is placed on [V], its skill puts this Crest face up into your Crest Zone.

faqs.question: How does the power scaling work?
faqs.answer: Every face up card in your G-Zone gives your Vanguard and both front row rear-guards +5,000 Power during your turn. With 2 face-up cards, that's +10,000 to the entire front row! With 4 face-up cards, +20,000 power to all three front row circles!

faqs.question: When Alfred attacks, can I call cards into rear-guard circles that are already occupied?
